thread_text:
Lena Ortiz: Heads-up from recruiting ops: several panels created this morning show 'no interviewer assigned' even though ATS export included interviewer ids. Affected panels: 9472, 9473, 9480. Any permission changes rolled recently?
Tom Nguyen: I deployed the role-mapping change last night to normalize external role names -> internal interviewer_role. Might've tightened a check that rejects unknown roles.
Harper Reed: Recruiting saw this error when assigning: HTTP 403 Forbidden from our permission service: 
``nPermissionError: user_has_no_role 
context: {"interviewer_id":"u_292", "requested_role":"panel_lead_external"}"\nSofia Alvarez: ATS still sends 'panel_lead_external' for older interviewers. Our connector was supposed to map that to 'panel_lead' but looks like the mapping table didn't include the legacy key.
Tom Nguyen: Sorry, I missed that legacy mapping. Quick fix: add mapping entry and make the importer tolerant of unmapped roles for 24h. I'll open a patch.
Lena Ortiz: We need interviews to have assigned interviewers before afternoon slots. Can we backfill assignments after fix?
RecruitBot: alert: role-mapper failed_count=14 last_failed_panel=9480 request_id=req_z3c4
Harper Reed: Importer log shows: 
ERROR assign_interviewer: unmapped_role 'panel_lead_external' -> aborting assignment for panel 9472
Tom Nguyen: Plan: 1) patch mapping table (10m), 2) deploy a tolerant importer flag (ignore unmapped roles and attach as 'interviewer' fallback) (15m), 3) run targeted backfill for panels 9472/9473/9480.
Sofia Alvarez: I'll coordinate with recruiting ops to hold any new panel creation for 30m and notify affected hiring teams. Also will add a note in the interviewer guide clarifying legacy role names mapping.
Tom Nguyen: Patch pushed to canary. Backfill command (ops-only): `./tools/ats-assign --panel 9472 --force-map-fallback`
Harper Reed: Running canary watch now. I'll post backfill success counts when available.
RecruitBot: ticket created R-2026-899: "Role mapping regression causing missing interviewer assignments" assigned to Tom Nguyen due 2026-06-25
Lena Ortiz: Thanks. Please paste backfill output here so HR can confirm all interviews have scorecards and assigned leads before the afternoon.
Tom Nguyen: Will do. Posting results shortly.
